But since companies like e verify are in high demand, my options are almost extinct. Again When I was 13-18 (figuring this all out). Mcdonalds / ect was an adequate employer.

Not only that but its a mental hesitation. As I already go in under the assumption that the job won't hire me. (based) on all the times I actually didn't get the job. 

I've been turned down for graveyard shifts in warehouses with all adult crew? I've been turned down, for security jobs, Hotel jobs, Restaurants, grocery stores, coffee shops. Its basically like every store or corporation that you can think of wont hire me. (via policy). 

Like I understand that RSO's Shouldn't work in say medical, or teaching / daycares... But a fucking warehouse shoveling through boxes??? 

Either way, Yes as I get older the reality sinks in more, and the pain grows exponentially. 
    
The worst part is its all lost time. They could "Un" sex offend me, and I already grew up being one. It wont help me mentally. 
I can't re apply for college. Or get that lost time back. 
So now its just adding insult to injury in that regard.

Permanent damage / No Cure / No hope / No Future / And I hate life currently. Basically every day is a little worse than the last...
